name: splitstream-sdk-cli
description: Operational cockpit for simulating, checking, and claiming SplitStream payouts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @splitstream/sdk && npm run build -w splitstream-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @splitstream/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @splitstream/sdk && npm run typecheck -w splitstream-cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @splitstream/sdk && npm run test -w splitstream-cli
